benchmark.test_policy: Freeze thresholds and algorithm configuration before opening sealed-test metrics
benchmark.visibility: at least one patch >=70% target over pair and >=65% each frame; absence requires zero target pixels both frames
benchmark.exclusions: first tubelet and visible slivers with no eligible patch
benchmark.identity_switch: transition between predicted car IDs on unambiguous visible targets, initialized to true source ID; last ID retained over missing outputs

conditions.long_occlusion: stationary foreground wall hides A for extended interval; return and reappearance; B moves separately
conditions.crossing: two distinct-bodied cars exchange diagonal positions; foreground B occludes A; visible context resolves identity
conditions.scale_camera: up to 15% sprite scale, 8-degree in-plane rotation, global camera translation, moving repeated-colour distractors

benchmark.limitations: 2-D rendered sprites, fixed same-colour target appearance; no 3-D viewpoint change, real faces, generative rendering or causal encoder claim

manifest.features: frozen FP16; four disjoint16frame windows; offline attention within each window
